column1: # Game profile of Luigi's Mansion 3 (Switch, update 1.4.0 = v327680).
# Next Level Games' engine on NVN, SDK 7.3.2 (the sdk build of Super Mario Odyssey and DRAGON QUEST XI S), Havok physics and cloth, Wwise sound (wwiseaudio/*.pck), NEX / Pia online.
# Every RomFS file but the Wwise banks is an archive of the engine's own: '<name>.dict' indexes zlib chunks in '<name>.data', and update 1.4.0 ships '<name>.patch' beside the unchanged base
# files (shader_split.py nlg_shaders). All 5,317 shaders are in init (5,149 in the base game), one NVN program per stage.

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# only the merged 1.4.0 copy is extracted
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk. subsdk0 ('nnSdkEn') is a second copy of the SDK: its code is byte for byte sdk's, only its module name and build ID differ; it comes first,
# so main's imports bind to it. subsdk1 = NintendoSDK_movie
# no virtual address memory (the NPDM declares no system resource): main sets a heap
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the frame limiter waits until 33.333 ms have passed since the frame started, a constant the host sets to 1000 / fps_target (hle_fpslock.c), and the game
# steps by the time that really passed (the same walk in the lobby ends at the same spot at 30 and 60 fps). The game asks for present interval 2 as well, which display ignores
# Luigi moves with the left stick and aims with the right; the D-pad calls up the Virtual Boo: the iPhone pad starts in the 3D layout, which has both
# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0): the pipeline archive made offline holds the main0_z vertex entries (dm/gfx/tools/pso_offline.py)
